content: Information on the language level of a simplified German text (typically A1, A2, or B1) is particularly valuable, as it allows for conducting automatic readability assessment and graded automatic text simplification experiments on the data. 52 websites and 233 PDFs (amounting to approximately 26,000 sentences) have an explicit language level label.
